import django
from django.conf import settings

from django import forms
from django.forms import CheckboxInput
from django.contrib.postgres.forms import SplitArrayField

# 1. Caller-supplied attrs must not be mutated by CheckboxInput.get_context().
attrs = {'id': 'id_x', 'class': 'c'}
w = CheckboxInput()
if hasattr(w, 'get_context'):
    w.get_context('x', True, attrs)
    print('caller attrs after get_context:', attrs)
    assert attrs == {'id': 'id_x', 'class': 'c'}, 'attrs mutated!'

# 2. Rendered HTML: only the True slot should be checked.
f = SplitArrayField(forms.BooleanField(required=False), size=3)
html = str(f.widget.render('arr', [True, False, False], attrs={'id': 'id_arr'}))
print(html)
inputs = [line for line in html.splitlines() if '<input' in line]
checked = [('checked' in line) for line in inputs]
print('checked flags per input:', checked)
assert checked == [True, False, False], checked

# 3. All False / all True / None cases.

    got = [('checked' in line) for line in h.splitlines() if '<input' in line]

    assert got == expected, (vals, got, expected)

print('ALL CHECKS PASS')
